rationale: The visible producer report and evidence support the assertion: the recovery runner evidence states it performs adapter training/checkpoint copying and writes recovery CSVs, a ledger, summaries, and state; the large-eval runner evidence states it writes manifests, audit/summary JSON, and state in normal modes. The report explicitly says no full reproduction was attempted because these surfaces would write under experiments/stage10, and evidence [3] identifies the final-report audit as a safe non-regenerating command. This is sufficient to accept the read-only constraint conclusion, though the exact boundary of all possible safe stdout-only checks is supported mainly by the producer summary rather than separate artifact evidence.
